chunks: And from him, from Abu Ali al-Ash'ari, from Muhammad ibn Abd al-Jabbar and Muhammad ibn Isma'il, from al-Fadl ibn Shadhan, from Safwan, from Ibn Muskan, from al-Halabi, who said:

I asked Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him): 'Did any of your forefathers ever fast in the month of Sha'ban?' He said: 'The best of my forefathers, the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family), fasted it.'

key_terms.شَعْبَان: Sha'ban (the eighth month of the Islamic lunar calendar)

ai.seo_question: Did the Prophet Muhammad fast in the month of Sha'ban according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: In this narration from *Tahdhib al-Ahkam*, Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) affirms that the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him and his family) fasted during Sha'ban, thereby validating the practice as a Sunnah rooted in the Prophet himself rather than merely an Imami innovation. This hadith is frequently cited by Shia jurists to support the recommendation (mustahabb) of fasting in Sha'ban, particularly in the first half of the month, aligning with the broader tradition of voluntary fasting to prepare for Ramadan.
